adds.name: Arc Reactor
adds.why: Freed by the Tony Stark fold (Nov 16). Five-mana artifact with improvise that grows T'Challa; sidegrade for Thran Dynamo.

adds.name: Mjölnir, Storm Hammer

name: Black Panther: Vibranium Forge
notes: Nov 24, 2026: Scourglass out, Aladdin's Ring in. Scourglass wiped T'Challa and nearly every creature in the deck. The Ring is repeatable removal or reach (4 damage to any target), can be paid with Vibranium/colorless mana, triggers Zuri/W'Kabi/T'Challa as an 8-MV artifact and discounts Metalwork Colossus by 8. Kept Coveted Jewel (tap it the turn it lands) and Mind's Eye.

Nov 23, 2026 (pending, not made yet): consider Talisman of Progress (2 spares in the bulk box from the precons) in for Avacyn's Pilgrim. A rock survives his own Martial Coup / Vanquish the Horde, counts as an artifact for Metalwork Colossus, and gets a 4-mana artifact out on turn 3. Talisman of Hierarchy (bulk box) works too. Pilgrim would go back to the bulk box.
Nov 23, 2026: Birds of Paradise pulled for Andrew's Tom's Bombs; Avacyn's Pilgrim in (from the Token Triumph bulk box) — same 1-drop slot, and its white mana casts everything here.

Nov 23, 2026: now the oldest's A-tier deck (swapped with Hulk). Precon Rip re-run: Black Panther keeps Idol of Oblivion, Loyal Guardian, Dispatch, Scavenger Grounds, Martial Coup and the Token Triumph upgrades (Conclave Tribunal, White Sun's Zenith, Curse of Bounty); its rip Terramorphic Expanse went to Hulk, so sleeve one of the spares instead.
Stock precon. Six directions: big artifacts, monarch, commander equipment, go-wide tokens, +1/+1 counters, and generic ramp. Scrollvault rates it a 4.6/10 Bracket 2 deck.

Vibranium tokens are indestructible artifacts that tap for {C}, and that mana can only cast artifact spells. T'Challa makes one when he enters or attacks and gets two +1/+1 counters whenever you cast an artifact with mana value 4 or more.

Weak spots: Divine Visitation, Martial Coup, Overwhelming Stampede, Vanquish the Horde and Harmonize can't use Vibranium mana. Coveted Jewel hands opponents mana and the crown in one hit. M'Baku gives an opponent the monarch.
source: Stock Wakanda Forever precon list (mtg.wtf), Nov 7, 2026

adds.name: Big Mother Mouser
adds.why: Option, replacing Loyal Guardian. A 4-mana colorless artifact creature (TMNT Commander) that grows T'Challa. Enters with two +1/+1 counters, doubles them each attack, and leaves a 1/1 Robot artifact token per counter when it dies. Iron Man Armor gives it flying.

adds.name: Don't Move
adds.why: Option, replacing Helm of the Host. Cast it before combat: it destroys every creature that attacked you last turn (they're still tapped), then kills any creature that taps before your next turn. That locks the table out of attacking you and protects the monarch. Don't attack, crew or tap Birds that turn.

adds.name: Martial Coup
adds.why: Option, replacing Conduit of Worlds. At 7 mana it's a one-sided wipe that leaves you five 1/1 Soldiers. Can't use Vibranium mana.

adds.name: Vanquish the Horde
adds.why: Option. A cheap full wipe when the board is crowded. Your Equipment, Vibranium and uncrewed Vehicles survive, but T'Challa doesn't.

adds.name: Overwhelming Stampede
adds.why: Weakest of the four. A one-shot finisher that needs a wide board, and it can't use Vibranium mana.

adds.name: Super-Soldier Serum
adds.why: Option. A 2-mana Aura for T'Challa: +2/+2, first strike and vigilance, so he can attack and still block for the monarch. Each time he attacks, attach any number of your Equipment to him for free. It's an Aura, so removal costs you a card.

adds.name: Divine Visitation
adds.why: Option, best with the token makers (Okoye's Soldiers, Kimoyo Beads, Royal Talon, Peregrin Took, Mouser Robots). Every creature token becomes a 4/4 flying Angel. Can't use Vibranium mana.

adds.name: Greater Good
adds.why: Option. Sacrifice a creature in response to removal to draw cards equal to its power, then discard three. Best on a big T'Challa or a grown Mouser. Can't use Vibranium mana.

adds.name: Black Panther, Wakandan King
adds.why: Option, strong. A 2-mana 2/2 first striker. Whenever it or another creature you control enters (tokens too), put a +1/+1 counter on a land. {3}: move them all to a creature, gain that much life and draw a card. Card draw that doesn't need the monarch, and it piles counters on T'Challa or the Mouser.

adds.name: Black Panther, Vanguard
adds.why: Option. A 4-mana 4/4. Whenever another nontoken Hero enters, make a 1/1 Soldier or give the team +1/+1. Only as good as the deck's Hero count.

adds.name: Loyal Retainers
adds.why: Option. Sacrifice on your turn before attacks to return a legendary creature from your graveyard to the battlefield: Storm, Ramonda, Okoye, Shuri, or T'Challa if you leave him in the graveyard.

adds.name: Terramorphic Expanse
adds.why: Land option, replaced by Ancient Den. Slow fixing in a two-color deck that doesn't need much.

adds.name: Scavenger Grounds
adds.why: Land option, replaced by Rogue's Passage. Colorless land with one-shot graveyard hate.

adds.name: Genji Glove
adds.why: Top equipment pick, on hold until Cloud's Glove is confirmed. 5 mana, so it grows T'Challa. Double strike, plus an untap and an extra combat on the first attack each turn: two Vibranium tokens, two shots at the monarch.

adds.name: Colossus Hammer
adds.why: Option only with Super-Soldier Serum, which attaches it for free on attack: +10/+10. Equip 8 otherwise. Removes flying, so it fights Iron Man Armor and Midnight Angel Armor.

adds.name: Darksteel Plate
adds.why: Option. Makes T'Challa indestructible, which covers destroy wipes. 3 mana, so no T'Challa trigger. Doesn't stop exile.

adds.name: Loxodon Warhammer
adds.why: Option. +3/+0, trample and lifelink. Fine, but 3 mana and equip 3, so it doesn't feed the engine.

adds.name: Vibranium Energy Daggers
adds.why: Option, low. 1-mana indestructible, +2/+2, but equip 3. Flavor win, power loss.

adds.name: Swordsman's Steel
adds.why: Option only if a third copy turns up. Both copies are in Bucky (Marvel B2) and the five-deck Marvel package.

adds.name: Trading Post
adds.why: Option, much better with Divine Visitation. A 4-mana artifact, so it grows T'Challa. {1},{T}, pay 4 life: a 0/1 Goat, which Visitation turns into a 4/4 flying Angel every turn. {1},{T}, sacrifice an artifact: draw a card (Food, Robot tokens), which is card draw that doesn't need the monarch. It can also return an artifact from your graveyard.

adds.name: Steel Seraph
adds.why: Strong option, replacing Panther Habit. Cast for 6, it's a 5/4 flying artifact Angel that Vibranium pays for, and it grows T'Challa. Each combat it gives T'Challa flying (reach the monarch), vigilance (attack and still guard it) or lifelink. Prototype for {1}{W}{W} as a 3/3 when you need it early.

adds.name: Idol of Oblivion
adds.why: Strong option, replacing Selesnya Signet. Vibranium tokens are tokens, so every time T'Challa makes one, Idol taps to draw a card: steady draw that doesn't need the monarch. Soldiers, Goats, Robots and Angels also count. Late game: {8}, sacrifice for a 10/10. With Divine Visitation out, that token becomes a 4/4 Angel instead, so sacrifice it before Visitation lands or skip that mode.

adds.name: Arc Reactor
adds.why: Sidegrade option for Thran Dynamo. 5 mana with improvise, so tapping Vibranium tokens and other artifacts often makes it cheap, and it still grows T'Challa. Taps for {C}{C}{C} but enters tapped. The deck has enough mana already.

adds.name: Bastion Protector
adds.why: Option. 3-mana 3/3: T'Challa gets +2/+2 and indestructible, so destroy wipes stop costing you commander tax. Doesn't cover Helm copies (they aren't commanders) or exile. Swap for Valorous Stance or Darksteel Plate.

adds.name: Agent Phil Coulson
adds.why: Low option. 2-mana 2/2 vigilance; tap to put a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero. The deck doesn't run enough Heroes to make it worth a slot.

variants.name: Black Panther: Vibranium Forge
notes: Plan: T'Challa attacks, makes Vibranium, and that mana pays for 4+ mana artifacts. Each one grows him, Zuri pumps the team, and W'Kabi makes a 4/4 Rhino on attack. Monarch is the card engine: Okoye, Ramonda, Nakia, Spear, Frogs, T'Chaka, Fight for the Throne, Heart-Shaped Herb, Palace Jailer and Throne of the High City take or retake it.

Cut 9: the non-artifact token package (Divine Visitation, Martial Coup, Overwhelming Stampede, Vanquish the Horde), Coveted Jewel, M'Baku, Trading Post, Loyal Retainers and Greater Good. Terramorphic Expanse out for Ancient Den. Scavenger Grounds out for Rogue's Passage.

Equipment goes from 8 to 13. Omnitool and Iron Man Armor are cheap ways to start, Nettlecyst and Omnitool grow with every Vibranium token, and Swordsman's Steel draws one card per Equipment, so it refills your hand late. Iron Man Armor attaches itself and gives flying, so T'Challa can reach the monarch.

Equipment goes from 8 to 12. Omnitool and Iron Man Armor are cheap ways to start, and Nettlecyst and Omnitool grow with every Vibranium token. Iron Man Armor attaches itself and gives flying, so T'Challa can reach the monarch.

Collection check Nov 7: spares on hand for the new cards except Swordsman's Steel (both copies are in other Marvel builds). Mind's Eye stays from the precon in that slot: a 5-mana artifact that grows T'Challa and draws without needing the monarch. Swap Swordsman's Steel back in for it if a third copy turns up.
Not legal here: Shuri, Vibranium Technologist from the Wakanda Jumpstart packet. Her {W/U} hybrid symbol makes her color identity white-blue.
Next upgrades to consider: Thought Vessel, more artifact lands (Tree of Tales), and Hulkbuster Armor or Hero's Blade if a spare turns up.
Nov 9: Captain America's Shield in for Conduit of Worlds. Indestructible, vigilance so T'Challa attacks and still guards the monarch, and it taps a blocker when he attacks.
Nov 9: Puresteel Paladin in for Ingenious Smith. With three artifacts every Equipment has equip {0} (Helm of the Host included), and each Equipment entering draws a card.

variants.label: Crown & Forge
variants.name: Black Panther: Crown & Forge
notes: Plan: T'Challa attacks every turn for Vibranium, and the 4+ mana artifacts it pays for grow him and the team. Monarch is the card engine: Okoye, Ramonda, Nakia, T'Chaka, Palace Jailer, Spear, Frogs, Fight for the Throne, Herb and Throne of the High City. Evasion and vigilance keep the crown: Iron Man Armor, Whispersilk Cloak, Rogue's Passage, Captain America's Shield, Super-Soldier Serum. Tokens crew the ships and become Angels: Divine Visitation turns Okoye's Soldiers, Kimoyo Beads, Royal Talon, Trading Post Goats, Mouser Robots and Martial Coup into 4/4 fliers.

Helm of the Host is a top engine: Hammer of Nazahn attaches it free on entry (or Super-Soldier Serum on attack), and each combat makes a hasty, nonlegendary T'Challa copy that makes Vibranium on entering and attacking and grows with every 4+ artifact. With Divine Visitation out the copy becomes a 4/4 hasty Angel instead, so pick which one to lean on.

Cut directions: Overwhelming Stampede and Vanquish the Horde, +1/+1 counter filler (Loyal Guardian, Fleecemane Lion), slow value (Gilded Lotus, Conduit, Coveted Jewel, Greater Good) and conditional cards (Bast, Everett Ross, Hatut Zeraze, M'Baku, Loyal Retainers, Midnight Angel Armor, Ancestral Communion).
Counts: 37 lands, 10 ramp pieces plus Vibranium, 12 Equipment, about 11 draw sources outside the monarch, 12 removal or wipes, and 8 protection pieces.
Bracket 2: no Game Changers, no infinite combos, no land destruction. For Bracket 3, swap Trading Post, Harmonize and Heart-Shaped Herb for The One Ring, Smothering Tithe and Enlightened Tutor.
Don't Move: cast before combat and don't attack, crew or tap Birds that turn. Vibranium tokens aren't creatures, so tap them freely.
Captain America's Shield is a confirmed spare. Vibranium Mining Mech and N'Yami-Class Mother Ship are going in.
Super-Soldier Serum turns Colossus Hammer into a free +10/+10 on attack if you want a spicier swap.
Nov 9: Puresteel Paladin in for Ingenious Smith. With three artifacts every Equipment has equip {0} (Helm of the Host included), and each Equipment entering draws a card.

Nov 19: Mind Stone in for Birds of Paradise. An artifact rock counts for Puresteel metalcraft and improvise, doesn't die to wipes or Don't Move, and cycles for a card late. The deck now runs no mana dorks.
variants.source: Streamlined by Claude from the Vibranium Forge build plus the options list, Nov 8, 2026
